tools.price_text: Free; Personal $9/month; Pro $20/month with unlimited members on the displayed plan. Usage credits and add-on capacity apply.
tools.integration_setup: Connect the project or upload supported output; configure build settings and secrets; deploy; connect the domain; test functions, forms and redirects.
tools.constraints: The app needs compatible source or build output. Deployments, compute, bandwidth and requests share plan-related usage rules.

observed_price_mentions.context: Free; Personal $9/month; Pro $20/month with unlimited members on the displayed plan. Usage credits and add-on capacity apply.

tools.name: Render
tools.description: Cloud hosting for web services, workers, databases and scheduled jobs.
tools.price_text: Free and paid service options; paid cost is based on service resources and workspace features. Current numerical instance pricing requires confirmation.
tools.integration_setup: Select a prepared deployment template or repository; configure runtime and secrets; create the database if needed; deploy and test health checks.
tools.constraints: A service template must already implement the app. Free instances and managed databases have limits; persistent storage must be planned.

tools.name: Cloudflare Pages
tools.description: Cloudflare static-site deployment with optional server-side functions and related services.
tools.price_text: Static-site entry offering is free; functions and associated Workers, storage or database usage can be charged separately.
tools.integration_setup: Upload supported static output or connect a repository; configure environment variables and bindings; attach a domain; test routing and any function endpoints.
tools.constraints: Dynamic capabilities depend on Workers and bindings. A hosted frontend alone does not provide private app data or business workflows.

tools.name: DigitalOcean
tools.description: Managed application hosting through DigitalOcean App Platform.
tools.price_text: Free tier for static sites; paid app compute from $5/month. Databases, transfer, storage and larger resources cost extra.
tools.integration_setup: Select a prepared app or repository; configure build and runtime settings; add secrets and services; deploy; test health checks and backup access.
tools.constraints: Containers and code are still required underneath. Templates reduce setup but do not eliminate maintenance or application design.

observed_price_mentions.context: Free tier for static sites; paid app compute from $5/month. Databases, transfer, storage and larger resources cost extra.

tools.name: Railway
tools.description: Usage-based deployment for applications, databases and prepared service templates.
tools.price_text: Free allowance; Hobby $5 minimum monthly usage; Pro $20 minimum monthly usage. Credits apply toward resources, with overages beyond them.
tools.integration_setup: Deploy a maintained template; configure database and app secrets; attach the domain; verify persistent volumes and health checks; test restart recovery.
tools.constraints: Memory, CPU, storage and network usage are separate meters. Review template behavior before connecting live business accounts.

observed_price_mentions.context: Free allowance; Hobby $5 minimum monthly usage; Pro $20 minimum monthly usage. Credits apply toward resources, with overages beyond them.

tools.name: UptimeRobot
tools.description: Website and endpoint uptime monitoring with alerts and status pages.
tools.price_text: Free for eligible hobby or nonprofit use; Solo $10/month monthly or $9 annually. Larger tiers and extra features cost more.
tools.integration_setup: Add the website or API health URL; set interval and expected response; connect email or webhook alerts; trigger a controlled failure; verify recovery alerts.
tools.constraints: An HTTP 200 check cannot prove checkout or login works. Confirm commercial plan eligibility and API-feature availability.

tools.name: Better Stack
tools.description: Monitoring, incident response, logs and status pages.
tools.price_text: Free personal tier; responder license $34/month monthly or $29 annually. Logs, telemetry and additional features are separately metered.
tools.integration_setup: Create monitors and alert policies; connect Slack or another notification route; add log ingestion where supported; test an incident and recovery.
tools.constraints: Use uptime checks for a no-code baseline. Deep logs and traces require application or infrastructure integration.

tools.name: Sentry
tools.description: Error monitoring, tracing and related application diagnostics.
tools.price_text: Developer free for one user; Team $26/month and Business $80/month on the annual view. Additional events and other products can add cost.
tools.integration_setup: Create a project; install a supported SDK or plugin; set environment and release values; configure alerts; trigger a test error and confirm private data is excluded.
tools.constraints: Full instrumentation usually needs code or a prepared adapter. Error counts and tracing volume are separate usage considerations.

observed_price_mentions.context: Developer free for one user; Team $26/month and Business $80/month on the annual view. Additional events and other products can add cost.

tools.name: Datadog
tools.description: Infrastructure and application monitoring, logs and operational observability.
tools.price_text: Priced separately by product and usage, such as hosts, log volume and traces. Use a scoped quote; there is no single all-in app price.
tools.integration_setup: Select only needed products; connect the cloud integration or agent; send metrics and logs; define monitors; test an actionable alert.
tools.constraints: Deep instrumentation requires technical access. Avoid enabling broad telemetry without estimating ingestion and retention costs.

tools.name: Checkly
tools.description: API, browser and uptime monitoring for testing real application journeys.
tools.price_text: Hobby free; Starter $24/month and Team $64/month billed annually. Extra monitors and browser checks cost more.
tools.integration_setup: Add endpoint checks with assertions; configure secrets and schedules; connect alerts; test a known failure; use prepared browser checks for critical journeys.
tools.constraints: Browser journeys commonly require Playwright or a prepared test. Simple uptime checks remain available without a full test script.

observed_price_mentions.context: Hobby free; Starter $24/month and Team $64/month billed annually. Extra monitors and browser checks cost more.

tools.name: Statuspage
tools.description: Public or private service status pages and incident communication.
tools.price_text: Public free tier available; Hobby $29/month; private Starter $79/month. Audience, component and feature limits vary.
tools.integration_setup: Create service components; connect monitoring through the API or integration; define incident templates; test updates and resolution; confirm subscriber delivery.
tools.constraints: A status page communicates incidents but does not detect every failure. Prevent noisy monitors from publishing misleading incidents.

tools.name: BambooHR
tools.description: HR platform for employee records, onboarding, time off and related workflows.
tools.price_text: Core from $10/employee/month for the stated eligible company-size band; smaller companies and add-ons follow separate pricing terms.
tools.integration_setup: Authorize an approved HR connection; limit access to necessary fields; synchronize employee IDs and approved lifecycle changes; test with non-sensitive sample records.
tools.constraints: API permissions mirror account access. Payroll, sensitive fields and production integration eligibility require employer configuration.

observed_price_mentions.context: Core from $10/employee/month for the stated eligible company-size band; smaller companies and add-ons follow separate pricing terms.

tools.name: Gusto
tools.description: US payroll and HR platform with approved integration and embedded payroll products.
tools.price_text: Simple $49/month plus $6/person/month; Plus $80 plus $12/person. Embedded payroll pricing and partner access are separate.
tools.integration_setup: Confirm partner or connector eligibility; authorize the employer; map employee and payroll identifiers; synchronize approved data; validate in the provided test environment.
tools.constraints: A payroll subscription does not grant unrestricted payroll API access. Keep payroll submission under the employer's authorized workflow.

tools.name: Deel
tools.description: Global workforce platform for contractor management, employment services and HR.
tools.price_text: Contractor management from $49/contractor/month; EOR from $599/employee/month. Country, service and payroll packages differ.
tools.integration_setup: Authorize the organization; choose permitted HR or contract endpoints; map worker IDs; synchronize approved changes and status events; test access boundaries.
tools.constraints: Contractor management and employer-of-record are different products. Some actions require approval, verification or region-specific workflows.

tools.name: Rippling
tools.description: HR, payroll, IT and finance platform with configurable integrations.
tools.price_text: Modular quote based on workforce, products and contract. Current public numerical rates were not retrievable.
tools.integration_setup: Confirm API or approved-app access; authorize the company; select minimum data scopes; synchronize worker and organization identifiers; test approved lifecycle events.
tools.constraints: Developer access and individual modules can be restricted. Do not assume every payroll or IT action is exposed to a generic connector.

tools.name: Personio
tools.description: HR software for employee records, recruiting and workforce operations.
tools.price_text: Custom quote based on employees and selected applications. No general public per-employee amount is supplied in the retrieved pricing page.
tools.integration_setup: Create an approved integration credential; allow required employee attributes; map identifiers; synchronize permitted changes; test joiner and leaver scenarios.
tools.constraints: API versions and field access differ by product. Production HR access needs the customer's administrator configuration.

tools.name: Zoho People
tools.description: HR management for employee records, leave, attendance and workflows.
tools.price_text: Free edition and paid per-user plans. Current numerical rates and free-user allowance were inconsistently exposed; confirm the local edition and term.
tools.integration_setup: Authorize Zoho OAuth in the correct region; select forms or employee resources; map employee IDs; configure approved workflows; test record permissions.
tools.constraints: Attendance, payroll connections and advanced automation may be separate. Restrict personal employee data to the minimum needed.

tools.name: Nango
tools.description: Infrastructure for customer OAuth connections, API calls, tools and data synchronization.
tools.price_text: Free limits; pay-as-you-go starts at $50/month in included credits. Connections, compute and transfer are metered; enterprise terms differ.
tools.integration_setup: Register provider credentials; integrate the connection UI; associate each connection with a Stitchr customer; implement actions or syncs; test refresh and revocation.
tools.constraints: Useful for Stitchr's own integration layer. It manages connection infrastructure; it does not automatically define business workflows or schemas.

observed_price_mentions.context: Free limits; pay-as-you-go starts at $50/month in included credits. Connections, compute and transfer are metered; enterprise terms differ.

tools.name: Merge
tools.description: Unified APIs that normalize data across categories such as HR, accounting, CRM and ticketing.
tools.price_text: First three production linked accounts free; displayed package $650/month for up to ten, then $65 per additional linked account.
tools.integration_setup: Choose an API category; embed account linking; map the normalized model to Stitchr records; handle webhooks and sync status; test unsupported fields.
tools.constraints: Unified APIs cover a defined subset of vendor features. Check read/write coverage, sync frequency and pricing by connected customer account.

tools.name: Paragon
tools.description: Embedded integration platform for adding customer-connected workflows to a SaaS product.
tools.price_text: Sales-assisted quote based on integration infrastructure and usage. A usable public numerical amount was not exposed.
tools.integration_setup: Build integrations; configure customer authentication; embed the connection interface; pass tenant context; trigger workflows and monitor failures.
tools.constraints: Visual workflow design does not remove the SDK integration needed in Stitchr. Confirm connector actions and commercial distribution rights.

tools.name: Apideck
tools.description: Unified API platform with customer credential management and normalized business data.
tools.price_text: Retrieved GBP Launch view: £599/month for 25 active consumers. API categories, higher consumer counts and overages affect the quote.
tools.integration_setup: Choose a unified API; embed credential authorization; assign a consumer ID per customer; map data; test rate limits and provider-specific fields.
tools.constraints: A consumer is a connected customer context, not an app end user. Verify live versus normalized behavior and endpoint coverage.

observed_price_mentions.context: Retrieved GBP Launch view: £599/month for 25 active consumers. API categories, higher consumer counts and overages affect the quote.

tools.name: Prismatic
tools.description: Embedded integration platform with visual workflows, customer configuration and monitoring.
tools.price_text: Custom pricing based on the embedded integration program and usage. Obtain a production quote for Stitchr's expected customers and executions.
tools.integration_setup: Build and version an integration; configure customer authentication; embed the marketplace or configuration flow; deploy per customer; test logs and recovery.
tools.constraints: Requires platform integration work in Stitchr. Connector availability does not imply that every action or custom field is supported.

tools.name: Cyclr
tools.description: Embedded automation platform for connecting SaaS products through reusable workflows.
tools.price_text: Commercial platform subscription and usage terms require a quote; current numerical pricing was not retrievable.
tools.integration_setup: Create an integration template; configure connectors and authentication; provision a customer account context; expose setup within Stitchr; test execution and disconnection.
tools.constraints: Confirm hosting region, connector coverage and embedding license. Workflow templates still need mappings and monitoring for each business use case.
